title: Fix RSA private key PEM import
summary: RSA private key import from PEM format now works correctly by using the proper RSA cryptographic service provider type instead of the base RSA type.
key_points: Fixed runtime failure when calling RSA.ToSecretXmlString with PEM private keys
RSAEncryptionHelper.ImportFromPem now receives the correct RSACryptoServiceProvider type
PEM key material remains wrapped as SecretText outside debuggable boundaries
Added test coverage for private key PEM import functionality
Public API unchanged; low risk update
